description: This file contains the implementation of a report in the ERPNext framework, specifically related to sales payment summaries, including functions to fetch and process sales invoice data, payment modes, and generate report columns, likely used within the Frappe/ERPNext ecosystem.

methods.name: execute(filters=None)
methods.description: Main entry point to generate the sales payment summary report, returning columns and data based on filters.

methods.name: get_pos_columns()
methods.description: Returns the column definition for POS sales data.

methods.name: get_columns(filters)
methods.description: Determines and returns the set of columns based on whether the filter indicates POS or Sales.

methods.name: get_pos_sales_payment_data(filters)
methods.description: Fetches and structures POS sales invoice data into a list suitable for reporting.

methods.name: get_sales_payment_data(filters, columns)
methods.description: Fetches and structures sales invoice data along with payment details, with or without payment breakdown, based on filters.

methods.name: get_conditions(filters)
methods.description: Generates SQL conditions based on provided filters for data retrieval.

methods.name: get_pos_invoice_data(filters)
methods.description: Retrieves POS invoice data from the database with aggregations.

methods.name: get_sales_invoice_data(filters)
methods.description: Retrieves sales invoice data with aggregate financial metrics.

methods.name: get_mode_of_payments(filters)
methods.description: Retrieves payment modes used for invoices within filters, grouped by owner and date.

methods.name: get_invoices(filters)
methods.description: Fetches list of invoice IDs matching the filters.

methods.name: get_mode_of_payment_details(filters)
methods.description: Retrieves detailed payment mode information and adjustments for invoices.
